evals.name: untangle-checkin-panel-state
evals.prompt: este componente tiene como 10 useState y 4 useEffect y a veces muestra el spinner arriba de la lista vieja, o queda el cartel de error cuando ya cargo bien. Lo podes dejar mas prolijo y que no se rompa? CheckInPanel.tsx
evals.expected_output: Boolean soup replaced by a discriminated union on status, derived values computed during render instead of in effects, the array mutation via push fixed, and exhaustive handling of the states.
assertions: Boolean flags are replaced by a discriminated union with a status field
Derived values (count, todayCount, isEmpty) are computed during render rather than in useEffect
The checkIns.push mutation is replaced by creating a new array
The status variants are handled exhaustively
The stale-error case named by the user can no longer be represented

evals.name: pure-core-membership-service
evals.prompt: quiero poder testear la logica de upgrade de membresia sin base de datos, hoy tengo que mockear todo. Y los errores son todos `throw new Error('...')` asi que arriba en el route termino haciendo if con el mensaje del error, medio asqueroso. Como lo encaro? membership-service.ts
evals.expected_output: Pricing/proration logic extracted into pure functions with time injected, mutation of the loaded entity replaced by returning new values, and a typed Result with a discriminated error union replacing thrown strings.
assertions: Proration and pricing logic are extracted into pure functions
The current time is injected as a parameter instead of calling new Date() inside the logic
The loaded membership object is no longer mutated in place
Errors are returned as a typed Result with a discriminated error union instead of thrown Error strings
A test is shown that exercises the logic without a database
The caller distinguishes error cases by a tag rather than by matching a message string
